#### 1. Lisch epithelial corneal dystrophy  —  Tier 1 — Definitive / Highly Plausible  (fitness 0.716)
**Link type:** shared pathway (Reactome:R-HSA-3295583, Reactome:R-HSA-917977)

Loss-of-function mutations in MCOLN1 disrupt normal lysosomal function and impair autophagosome-lysosome fusion, leading to the accumulation of undegraded material (phenotyped as abnormal lysosome morphology in ML4) and contributing to corneal opacities and dystrophy.

**How to falsify it:** Identification of pathogenic variants in MCOLN1 with a gain-of-function or dominant-negative effect, or the absence of MCOLN1 mutations in individuals with both mucolipidosis type IV and Lisch epithelial corneal dystrophy. _(variant: rs74378765)_

**Why it matters:** Understanding the shared role of MCOLN1 in lysosomal function and autophagosome-lysosome fusion provides a potential therapeutic target for both mucolipidosis type IV and Lisch epithelial corneal dystrophy, possibly through strategies aimed at restoring lysosomal function or enhancing autophagic clearance.
